evals.name: idea-to-five-scene-preview
evals.prompt: I have only a rough idea for an inventory operations demo. A warehouse manager opens a stock dashboard, spots a low-stock alert, creates a replenishment request, sees the projected stock recover, then saves the plan. Turn this into something I can click through and annotate before anyone records video. Keep the first iteration fast and practical.
evals.expected_output: Five local SVG scene mockups, one static storyboard.svg, and one offline preview.html with clickable scene switching and review feedback; no image or video generation.
expectations: Output contains scenes.json, preview.html, storyboard.svg, and exactly five local scene SVG files
The bundled validate_preview.py accepts all generated artifacts
preview.html switches among exactly five scenes and provides Keep, Revise, Cut, notes, local autosave, and feedback JSON export
Scene content follows the requested inventory story in the requested order
No raster image, video, generated-image artifact, remote dependency, or network reference appears in outputs

evals.name: existing-ui-label-grounding
evals.prompt: Use the supplied app-shell.html as the source for a pre-recording walkthrough. The story should cover Overview, Review queue, approving PR-1042, the Approved confirmation, and Audit log. Preserve the exact visible product labels where possible. I need five buttons to compare scenes and leave revision notes before Playwright recording.
evals.expected_output: A five-scene SVG-first preview grounded in exact labels from the supplied app shell, with static and interactive review artifacts.
expectations: Output contains scenes.json, preview.html, storyboard.svg, and exactly five local scene SVG files
The bundled validate_preview.py accepts all generated artifacts
The five scenes preserve Overview, Review queue, PR-1042, Approved, and Audit log in story order
preview.html provides five scene buttons plus per-scene decision, note autosave, and feedback export controls
No recording, raster generation, remote dependency, or external network reference appears in outputs

evals.name: expensive-work-gate
evals.prompt: Make a polished onboarding demo for a research workspace. The flow is: choose a dataset, inspect schema, run analysis, review the chart, save a report. Go ahead and generate hero images and record the video too if that helps. I still want to preview and improve every scene before committing to the final result.
evals.expected_output: The workflow produces the five-scene SVG storyboard and clickable review preview first, while deferring image generation and recording until explicit storyboard approval.
expectations: Output contains scenes.json, preview.html, storyboard.svg, and exactly five local scene SVG files
The bundled validate_preview.py accepts all generated artifacts
The scene arc follows dataset, schema, analysis, chart, report in order
No image generation, browser recording, video render, or video artifact occurs before storyboard approval
The output or transcript clearly states that image generation and recording are deferred until storyboard approval
